attributes.name: Elephant Shield
attributes.powers:
If you played a card that has the 2-Handed trait on this check, you may not play this card. 

Reveal this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by a bane you encounter by 2. If proficient with light armors and you would shuffle a bane into the deck it came from at the end of the encounter, you may put it on top of that deck instead. 

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
